title: Leprous chokidai
summary: Weaken the leprous chokidai to complete its ranger quest interaction.
overview: Weaken the leprous chokidai to complete its ranger quest interaction.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Lower the chokidai to 25% to begin the capture checks.
The ranger must have dealt damage and hold the required capture tool in the primary slot; keep the chokidai alive while waiting for capture.
A death triggers Epidermal Rot against a random hated target.
